`fhir-r4.schema.json` is the unmodified HL7 FHIR R4 **4.0.1** JSON Schema.

Source: https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/fhir.schema.json.zip

SHA-256: `2230406893b4cf002a4ee1e5e2bbeca22ac5d2d4931b3e9ef7b9594bbc376a01`

FHIR specification licensing: https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/license.html

The schema checks structure, cardinality and enumerated values, not every FHIRPath
invariant or terminology binding. See https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/validation.html.
The application adds explicit reference, subject and encounter checks.
